CENSUS RETURN

CENSUS RETURN of Resident and Nomadic Indians; Denominations to which they belong, with approximate
number belonging to each Denomination, as well as the number of Pagans in the Dominion of Canada by
Provinces, for the Year ended June 30, 1901.
